answer: Rotation is the whole defence. One key per task, burned on completion. A replayed submission hits a dead key and the payment is clawed back. Budget per fake identity: one key pair per task in flight, plus the float while rewards vest. An echo of a real agent's work buys nothing, because the key does not match the terrace it was issued for. Rewards vest across future epochs, so the payout arrives after the cost. That timing gap is the tax on volume, and a voyage of clones pays it on every account.
